rationale: The 1-minute tape shows extreme choppiness — a sharp drop to 70.70, a spike to 72.79, then a pullback to 71.53, and a partial recovery to 71.99 — all within five candles, indicating no clean directional structure. The bid-ask spread of 243 bps is prohibitively wide for an intraday trade, making the cost of entry and exit alone a significant headwind against any reasonable profit target. With no news catalyst, a volatile prior session (prior day range ~$8.73), and already one working order consuming buying power, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
